newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash crudes drift higher, La. sweets stronger.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash crudes drift higher, La. sweets stronger.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes drifted higher in late trade Tuesday afternoon, boosted by Louisiana sweet crude differentials, traders said.
Outright crude prices rallied sharply, gaining more than $1.00 for April West Texas Intermediate/Cushing to talk late at $22.00 per barrel.
Grade business saw Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James erase its discount to the benchmark to trade as high as 1 cts over the WTI/Cushing, some 10-15 cents stronger than Monday.
Traders said the lack of foreign crude for early April fueled the price rise.
